source_quote: All systems must enforce role-based access control policies.
description: Systems must implement role-based access control (RBAC) to restrict user access based on assigned roles.

source_quote: Multi-factor authentication shall be required for all privileged accounts.
parent_context: Section 1. Access Control. All systems must enforce role-based access control policies.
description: Privileged accounts require multi-factor authentication (MFA) to prevent unauthorized access.

source_quote: Organizations shall maintain audit logs for all system events for a minimum of 90 days.
description: Audit logs covering all system events must be retained for at least 90 days.

source_quote: Sensitive data shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent.
description: Data at rest must be protected with AES-256 encryption or a cryptographically equivalent algorithm.

source_quote: Encryption keys shall be rotated at least annually.
parent_context: Section 3. Data Protection. Sensitive data shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent.
description: Cryptographic keys must be rotated on at least an annual basis to limit exposure from key compromise.
